videoOptions.title: Video options
videoOptions.forThisStart: For this start only. Use defaults to inherit the bot's quality and this server's streaming settings.

videoPlayer.iceLoopbackMismatch: Preview ICE failed: the offer only advertises loopback (127.0.0.1) host candidates. That works for a browser on the Docker host itself, but not for a remote client. Set WEBRTC_NAT1TO1_IP to a LAN/Tailscale/public IPv4 the browser can reach, publish WEBRTC_UDP_PORT (WEBRTC_BIND_IP may stay on a local host address if the network forwards UDP), and avoid advertising 127.0.0.1 for remote preview.
videoPlayer.iceBaseHint: Check WEBRTC_UDP_PORT is published, WEBRTC_NAT1TO1_IP is an IPv4 the browser can reach (not 127.0.0.1 for a remote client), WEBRTC_BIND_IP publishes that UDP port on the Docker host, and UDP is allowed/forwarded. NGINX only proxies signaling — not WebRTC media.

sourceSwitch.title: Switch source
sourceSwitch.help: YouTube / Twitch URLs, direct http(s) video URLs, or a file already in the music folder.

videoDefaults.savedServer: Defaults for {{server}} saved — they apply to the next stream there
videoDefaults.savedGlobal: Streaming defaults saved — they apply to the next stream
videoDefaults.title: Streaming defaults
videoDefaults.description: Applied when a stream starts. Each stream can override quality, encoder and the no-viewer stop.
videoDefaults.customProfile: Custom — Advanced settings differ from the named profiles.
videoDefaults.announceAutoStopsDescription: Posts one line in the bot's channel when it stops by itself. When the no-viewer stop is longer than 1 minute, it also warns 1 minute before stopping a stream nobody is watching.
videoDefaults.defaultEncoderNote: Default encoder is {{encoder}}. {{hint}} Toggle under Advanced.
videoDefaults.encodeSpeedHelp: 0 = use sidecar default (VIDEO_CPU_USED / VIDEO_VP9_CPU_USED). 1–8 override software VP8/VP9 (higher is faster / softer). Hardware ignores this.
videoDefaults.preferHardware: Auto prefers hardware (VAAPI, NVENC, AMF or VideoToolbox) when a test encode succeeds
videoDefaults.capabilitiesDescription: Runs short test encodes on the media sidecar. VAAPI requires /dev/dri; NVENC requires an NVIDIA driver and, in Docker, the NVIDIA container runtime. AMF is available when the sidecar runs natively on Windows with an AMF-enabled FFmpeg build and a compatible AMD GPU/driver. VideoToolbox is available when the sidecar runs natively on macOS; it has not yet been verified on Apple hardware.
videoDefaults.noFfmpegOutput: No ffmpeg output was reported. Update the media sidecar to see it.
